output.subject: Your replacement debit card
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about your replacement debit card. We understand how disruptive it can be to wait for a card you rely on for everyday spending, and we're sorry for the frustration and inconvenience this has caused.

You told us that you ordered a replacement debit card on 8/16 and that it has not arrived, even though it shows as mailed. You asked us for an update on where your card is. You also mentioned that you would like to use your card through a digital wallet on your phone while you wait, and you asked how to set that up.

We have passed the details of your call to our Card Services team, who will review what happened with your replacement card. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

In the meantime, if your new card arrives or anything changes, please let us know so we can make sure our records are up to date.

Thank you for your patience while we look into this.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The call note says the representative reordered the card with expedited shipping and waived the fee; confirm both before mentioning either to the customer.
Decide whether to tell the customer about the reorder and its expected delivery time.
Check whether the original card should be blocked or has been cancelled, and say so if appropriate.
Confirm the digital wallet guidance given on the call was accurate and whether to restate it in writing.
Mailing address was verified on the call; it has been kept out of the reply.
